mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_post (project_id, author_id, title, content) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 120) AS contentPreview,
u.user_id AS authorId, u.name AS authorName, u.profile_image AS authorProfileImage
FROM project_post p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.user_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title, p.content, u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.profile_image AS userProfileImage, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM project_post p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
